TASK: Bounded read-only review of checkout address-error dialog against WCAG 2.1 AA: 2.4.3 Focus Order, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. Do not edit, certify compliance, or approve integration. JOURNEY `/checkout/address`: keyboard/screen-reader user enters invalid postal code, activates `Continue`, receives dialog, reads error, closes it, corrects postal code, retries. EXPECTED: focus enters modal at meaningful control/heading; invalid field is programmatically associated with error; close returns focus to `Continue`. BOUNDARY: Windows 11/Chrome 126/NVDA 2024.2 and macOS 14/Safari 17/VoiceOver. Changed: `src/checkout/AddressForm.tsx:88-132`, `src/checkout/AddressErrorDialog.tsx:20-61`; test `tests/checkout/address-dialog.keyboard.spec.ts:41-78`. CODE: `AddressForm.tsx:96` postal input `id=postal`, `aria-invalid={hasPostalError}`, `aria-describedby={hasPostalError?'postal-error':undefined}`; :103 `

Enter a valid postal code.

`; :118 `Continue` sets `dialogOpen=true` after failed validation, with no stored trigger ref. `AddressErrorDialog.tsx:27` `
`; :30 `

We could not verify that address

`; :43 close button visible text `Edit address`; :50-54 close only calls `setDialogOpen(false)`; changed code has no focus-entry/restoration call. RUNTIME: build `checkout-8f31c2`, 2026-08-12 10:15 UTC. `KBD-01` Chrome/Windows focus log: before activation active=`#continue`; after dialog, it remains behind modal; first Tab→`#edit-address`; Escape closes and active=``. `NVDA-01` NVDA/Chrome: invalid postal input announced invalid with `Enter a valid postal code`; dialog opening announces no title until Tab, then `Edit address, button`. `VO-01` VoiceOver/Safari: postal error association announced; opening leaves virtual cursor on `Continue`; closing places navigation at document start, not trigger. `AXE-01`: zero axe-core violations in dialog subtree; automation only, not proof of journey accessibility. `RENDER-01` screenshot+computed style at 1280x800: modal and visible focus indicator present; text/background contrast 7.1:1; no responsive-reflow evidence. OUTPUT: Required headings, in order: `## Findings`, `## Reviewed criteria`, `## Scope`, `## Evidence not available`, `## Residual uncertainty`. Findings first; each: severity, applicable criterion, changed-file location, journey/affected keyboard or screen-reader interaction, observed evidence, expected behavior, current test evidence, confidence, smallest verification/remediation. Tie barriers to changed path, journey, named criterion, and supplied observation; distinguish direct failures, test gaps, unknown/unverified behavior. State automated/rendered evidence limits. Work remains read-only; parent/human owner retain decision.
